# netbox_cable_terminations (Data Source)

Lists NetBox cable termination objects (`/api/dcim/cable-terminations/`) matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
data "netbox_cable_terminations" "all" {}

data "netbox_cable_terminations" "filtered" {
  filters = [
    { name = "q", value = "example" },
  ]
  limit = 10
}

output "cable_terminations_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_cable_terminations.filtered.items[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/dcim/cable-terminations/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of objects to return (default: all).

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The matching objects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.


<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>

- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `positions` (Set of Number) Positions.
- `termination` (String) Termination.
- `termination_id` (Number) Termination Id.
- `termination_type` (String) Termination Type.
- `url` (String) Url.
